listing.name: Sonic Adventure 2 (Dreamcast) — dreamcastRecomp (st44rplatinum)
listing.summary: Experimental Sonic Adventure 2 Dreamcast source project. Upstream reports title and file-selection screens with sound; the first stage and GPU renderer are planned. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA Sonic Adventure 2 Dreamcast disc in CUE or GDI form, including IP.BIN, 1ST_READ.BIN and PRS code modules. Keep your original files separately.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow upstream instructions to extract your disc with gdrom_extract and prs_modules, then generate code with dcrecompemit and build the native sa2 player with CMake. Keep your original disc available. Portcove does not install or prepare this source project automatically.

warnings: Upstream reports a memory-card warning, title/file-selection screens and sound. The first stage and GPU renderer are planned rather than completed. The framework and game belong to the same project; Portcove has not confirmed runtime behavior or gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
